verdict.rationale: Reflect documents that notes can be exported anytime into open formats like HTML or Markdown (reflect-docs-44), and this is independently corroborated by the founder confirming export to markdown/HTML is always available, addressing lock-in concerns (reflect-comm-8). This directly satisfies the AI-native user's need to export data in open formats and leave. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all data types (calendar sync, integrations, images/files) are included in the open-format export, and no independent audit of export completeness beyond notes.
